name: @danielalbinsson/aletheia-cli
description: Headless authority diff for Vercel eve agents — aletheia diff gates authority expansion in PRs.

scripts.build: esbuild ../../src/cli/aletheia.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=bin/aletheia.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='bin/aletheia.mjs'; fs.writeFileSync(p, fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/[ \t]+$/gm,'')); fs.chmodSync(p, 0o755); fs.copyFileSync(p, '../../.github/actions/capability-review/aletheia.mjs')"
